calculation.description: Contrarian cross-sectional signal that fades each asset's three-day cumulative return, normalized by its trailing 20-day return volatility and clipped for robustness. Values use only information available at the decision close.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.045601, 763 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.023214, 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.033582, 574 dates). The daily admission gates are met; longer-horizon predictive power decays materially. Small 15-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
